name: F4 Car Bluetooth Speaker
subtitle: 5W Wireless Speaker With FM
description: The F4 portable Bluetooth speaker combines a sporty car-shaped design with 5W RMS output, Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, stereo configuration, FM radio, and microSD card playback. Its battery-powered wireless design supports portable listening at home, on a desk, or outdoors.
story: Made for listeners who want a compact speaker with a distinctive automotive look, the F4 brings several playback options into one small device. Stream wirelessly from compatible Bluetooth devices, switch to the built-in FM radio, or play music directly from a microSD card. The listed Bluetooth range reaches up to 10 metres in open conditions. Its battery-powered design makes it suitable for moving between a study desk, bedroom, travel setup, or outdoor space without requiring continuous wall power.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
